data.name: LocalOnlySummary
data.value: Your encrypted vault remains on this device.

data.name: AuditStatus
data.value: This release has not completed an independent professional security audit.

data.name: RecoveryLimitation
data.value: Forgotten master passphrases cannot be recovered unless you retained configured recovery material.

data.name: HindiPreferenceSaved
data.value: Hindi language preference saved for the reviewed resource-backed interface. Unmigrated interface text may still appear in English.

data.name: SystemPreferenceSaved
data.value: System language preference saved. CipherNest uses an available reviewed catalog and falls back to English when a translation is unavailable.

data.name: TotpSeedSummary
data.value: For this item type, Secret is the Base32 TOTP seed. The seed is stored only inside the encrypted vault record. Generated codes are computed locally while unlocked and are not persisted.

data.name: TotpImportSummary
data.value: Paste a bounded otpauth://totp/... URI. The URI contains the seed, is processed locally, is cleared from this editor after import, and must be protected like the seed itself. HOTP is intentionally rejected.

data.name: TotpImportSemanticDescription
data.value: Sensitive TOTP setup URI to import locally

data.name: TotpCopySetupUriSemanticDescription
data.value: Copy a TOTP setup URI containing this encrypted seed using timed clipboard cleanup

data.name: TotpCopyCodeSemanticDescription
data.value: Copy the current one-time password temporarily

data.name: TotpSafetyWarning
data.value: Only import TOTP seeds you are authorized to use. Copying a seed, setup URI, or generated code can expose it through operating-system clipboard history or synchronization; CipherNest applies the same best-effort timed clipboard cleanup policy used for other secrets.

data.name: TotpValidityFormat
data.value: Valid for about {0} more seconds after refresh.

data.name: TotpInvalidSeedSettingsError
data.value: The TOTP seed or settings are invalid. Use a Base32 seed, 6 or 8 digits, and a period from 15 to 120 seconds.

data.name: TotpGenerateError
data.value: The one-time code could not be generated safely. The encrypted seed remains unchanged.

data.name: TotpCopyCodeError
data.value: The one-time code could not be copied safely. You can still read it directly while the vault remains unlocked.

data.name: TotpImportMissingUriError
data.value: Paste an otpauth://totp/... setup URI before importing.

data.name: TotpImportSuccess
data.value: TOTP setup URI imported locally. Review the account, issuer, algorithm, digits, and period before saving.

data.name: TotpImportInvalidError
data.value: The TOTP setup URI is invalid or unsupported. CipherNest accepts bounded otpauth://totp/... URIs only; HOTP and ambiguous parameters or labels are rejected.

data.name: TotpImportFailureError
data.value: The TOTP setup URI could not be imported safely. Existing item fields were not intentionally changed after the failure.

data.name: TotpCopyUriSuccess
data.value: TOTP setup URI copied with timed clipboard cleanup where supported. The URI contains the seed and must be protected like the seed itself.

data.name: TotpCopyUriInvalidError
data.value: A TOTP setup URI could not be created. Enter a valid Base32 seed and account name, then review the algorithm, digits, and period.

data.name: TotpCopyUriFailureError
data.value: The TOTP setup URI could not be copied safely. The encrypted vault item remains unchanged.

data.name: BiometricUnlockSemanticDescription
data.value: Authenticate with the device biometric system to unlock CipherNest

data.name: UnlockAlternativeLabel
data.value: or use your master passphrase / recovery key

data.name: UnlockRecoveryWarning
data.value: Forgotten passphrases cannot be recovered unless you saved the optional recovery key during setup. Biometric unlock never replaces that recovery limitation.

data.name: UnlockMasterSessionRequired
data.value: Enter the master passphrase to begin this security session. Biometric unlock becomes available for later locks during the configured period.

data.name: UnlockRateLimitFormat
data.value: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {0} seconds.

data.name: UnlockAuthenticationError
data.value: The passphrase is incorrect or the vault cannot be authenticated.

data.name: UnlockPeriodicMasterDue
data.value: The periodic master-passphrase check is due. Unlock with the master passphrase first.

data.name: UnlockBiometricPrompt
data.value: Authenticate to unlock your local CipherNest vault.

data.name: UnlockBiometricFailed
data.value: Biometric authentication was cancelled or failed. Use the master passphrase instead.

data.name: UnlockBiometricSecretUnavailable
data.value: The protected biometric unlock secret is unavailable. Unlock with the master passphrase and re-enable biometrics in Settings.

data.name: UnlockBiometricDataMismatch
data.value: Biometric unlock data no longer matches this vault. Use the master passphrase and configure biometrics again.

data.name: OnboardingLocalSummary
data.value: CipherNest stores the current release entirely on this device. No account or cloud service is required.

data.name: OnboardingRecoveryKeyExplanation
data.value: This key can unlock your vault if you forget the master passphrase. It is shown only during setup; CipherNest cannot retrieve it later. Store it separately from this device.

data.name: OnboardingRecoveryKeySavedAcknowledgement
data.value: I saved the recovery key in a separate safe place.

data.name: OnboardingRecoveryLimitationBody
data.value: If you lose the master passphrase and any optional recovery key, CipherNest cannot recover this local-only vault.

data.name: OnboardingStrengthInitial
data.value: Enter a long unique master passphrase.

data.name: OnboardingGenerateRecoveryOption
data.value: Generate an optional local recovery key and show it once

data.name: OnboardingMasterRequirementsErrorFormat
data.value: Master passphrase must contain between {0:N0} and {1:N0} supported characters and satisfy the strength requirement.

data.name: OnboardingVaultExistsError
data.value: A local vault already exists or could not be initialized safely.

data.name: OnboardingCreateFailureError
data.value: The local vault could not be created safely. No successful setup is being reported; check local storage access and try again.

data.name: AboutSecurityStatusBody
data.value: CipherNest uses established cryptographic primitives and local-only storage, but this release has not completed an independent professional security audit. Open source does not itself guarantee security.

data.name: AboutPrivacyTermsBody
data.value: The current release is local-only and does not intentionally send vault contents, analytics, or telemetry to a CipherNest service. User-initiated plaintext export leaves the protected vault boundary. Full repository notices are in PRIVACY.md and TERMS.md.

data.name: SettingsBiometricSummary
data.value: Biometrics are optional and never replace your master passphrase or recovery key. Enabling creates a random secondary unlock secret protected by the operating system secure storage.

data.name: SettingsRequireMasterRange
data.value: Range: 1–168 hours. A fresh app process always begins by requiring the master passphrase.

data.name: SettingsSecurityReviewSummary
data.value: Run the local weak/reused/duplicate/overdue audit or review CipherNest's privacy, threat-model, audit-status, and open-source information.

data.name: SettingsBackupRestoreSummary
data.value: Use a separate strong backup passphrase. CipherNest locks before taking a consistent snapshot. Backups include the encrypted database and encrypted attachments.

data.name: SettingsImportExportSummary
data.value: Encrypted backup is recommended. Generic CSV import and guarded plaintext CSV export are available for interoperability.

data.name: SettingsDangerZoneBody
data.value: Deleting the local vault cannot guarantee physical erasure from flash storage, filesystem snapshots, backups, or copies outside CipherNest.
